description: Focused fidelity validation suite — 5 scenarios covering expected quality risk profiles. Used by canary_discord_fidelity.js to verify the fidelity classifier works on real LLM outputs.

scenarios.notes: Complex request — high risk of shallow or domain-misaligned output. preview_mismatch eliminated (2026-03-28) via separate sandbox dirs. Expected baseline: artifact_complete_but_shallow from qwen-plus stub output.
scenarios.message: /coder: 做一个电商网站，包含商品列表页（网格布局）、商品详情页、购物车和简单结账流程，要用户能加购和删除商品。

scenarios.notes: CRM domain pack will be applied. Expect domain_noun_present check to run. Output should use customer/contact vocabulary. preview_mismatch not expected here (project_type=webapp_crm is the sandbox type).
scenarios.message: /coder: 做一个简单CRM系统，支持客户列表、客户详情查看、新建和编辑客户，后端要有客户数据API。

scenarios.notes: Simple well-defined scope. artifact_complete_but_shallow is the current production baseline (qwen-plus stub output). preview_mismatch eliminated via sandbox/app dir.
scenarios.message: /coder: 做一个待办事项网站，支持新增、完成和删除任务，界面要清爽，有简单的样式。

scenarios.notes: Static marketing site. Frontend-heavy. artifact_complete_but_shallow is the current production baseline. preview_mismatch eliminated via sandbox/html_site dir. Brain router may classify as single_file_html.
scenarios.message: /coder: 做一个SaaS产品落地页，包含主视觉、三段卖点、用户评价和一个CTA按钮，要有基本样式。

scenarios.notes: Pure utility script — no UI. artifact_complete_but_shallow is the current production baseline. preview_mismatch eliminated via sandbox/project dir. Brain router may classify as generic_coding_task.
scenarios.message: /coder: 写一个Node.js脚本，读取目录下所有JSON文件，合并成一个数组后输出到output.json，支持命令行传路径参数。
